# Bank of Hawai‘i to Reopen its Hawai‘i Island Branches Following Hurricane Nolo


HONOLULU


September 27th, 2026


Following Hurricane Nolo, Bank of Hawai‘i will reopen its branches on Hawai‘i Island for normal operating hours starting **tomorrow, Monday, Sept. 28** .


Weekdays: 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.
Saturdays: 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.
Sundays: closed
